name: Sergeant Boom-Boom
description: Sergeant Boom-Boom was a weapon owned by a Human mercenary named Corso Riggs by the end of the Cold War and into the following Galactic War, fought between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. While serving with a smuggler captain who worked as a privateer for the Republic, Riggs preferred using Sergeant Boom-Boom against the forces of the Empire.
